name: table-viewer
description: Fast viewer for Excel, CSV and TSV
author: Jonathan Marc Bearak

commands.title: Table Viewer: Open Preview to the Side
Table Viewer: Open in Text Editor
Table Viewer: Open Workbook at Worksheet

tableViewer.fontFamily.description: Font family used in table views. Leave empty to use the editor font (editor.fontFamily).

tableViewer.fontSize.description: Font size in pixels used in table views. Set to 0 to follow the editor font size (editor.fontSize).

tableViewer.tabOrientation.description: Default worksheet tab orientation. Can be overridden per file.

tableViewer.maxStoredFiles.description: Maximum number of files whose layout settings (column widths, row heights, scroll positions) are remembered. When the limit is reached, the least recently used entries are removed first.

tableViewer.csvMaxRows.description: Maximum rows to display for CSV/TSV files. Excess rows are truncated with a banner.

tableViewer.maxFileSizeMiB.description: Maximum file size in MiB for all file types (xlsx, xls, csv, tsv).

scripts.test:sqlite:backend: vitest run --no-file-parallelism src/test/sqlite-file-state-persistence.test.ts src/test/sqlite-file-state-schema.test.ts src/test/sqlite-file-state-validation.test.ts src/test/sqlite-multiprocess.test.ts src/test/sqlite-open-recovery.test.ts src/test/sqlite-runtime.test.ts src/test/vscode-state-database.test.ts
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run typecheck:integration
scripts.pretest:integration: npm run bundle && npm run bundle:webview && npm run compile:integration
scripts.probe:sqlite:electron: npm run desktop:ensure-electron && npm run bundle:desktop && electron dist/runtime-probes/electron-sqlite-runtime-probe.js
scripts.probe:sqlite:bundles: npm run bundle && npm run bundle:desktop && node desktop/check-sqlite-bundle-externals.mjs
scripts.probe:sqlite:runtimes: npm run probe:sqlite:host && npm run probe:sqlite:electron && npm run test:integration
scripts.probe:windows:durability: npm run desktop:ensure-electron && npm run bundle:desktop && electron dist/runtime-probes/windows-durability-probe.js
scripts.gate:sqlite:recovery: npm run desktop:ensure-electron && npm run bundle:desktop && electron dist/runtime-probes/packaged-recovery-gate.js
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run bundle && npm run bundle:webview
scripts.desktop:prepackage: npm run desktop:ensure-electron && npm run bundle:webview && npm run bundle:desktop && node desktop/collect-licenses.mjs
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:prepackage && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never --mac -c.mac.identity=null -c.dmg.sign=false
scripts.desktop:package:dir: npm run desktop:prepackage && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never --mac --dir -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.desktop:package:release: npm run desktop:prepackage && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never --mac --arm64
scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run desktop:prepackage && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never --win --x64 --arm64
scripts.test:desktop-smoke:relaunch: npm run desktop:prepackage && playwright test --config=desktop/test-smoke/playwright.config.ts desktop/test-smoke/state-relaunch.spec.ts
